introH2: 🏝️ How many kinds of hostel-style stays does Koh Chang have, and how do you pick one that fits your trip?
introHtml: The word "hostel" on Koh Chang doesn't mean just one thing, and that's exactly why choosing a budget stay here means reading the reviews carefully before you book — some are riverside hostels at the river mouth with a free speedboat shuttle to the beach, some are clean hostels walkable to Klong Prao Beach that lean quiet rather than party, some are budget stays in the middle of the island that sell on a low price and a flexible location, and some are hostels with a pool for just a few hundred baht. Plenty of people book a budget stay and then find it doesn't match their trip — whether it's a location away from the beach, an atmosphere quieter or livelier than expected, or facilities that aren't as complete as they assumed. This article gathers 4 hostel-style stays on Koh Chang that we've already reviewed in depth, across the Klong Prao, Chai Chet, Kai Bae and Bailan Bay areas — each one drawn from reading real guest reviews, telling you both the upsides and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites, and with direct booking links for all of them.
mrtHtml: Koh Chang has no rail line and no particularly convenient public transport. Getting around usually means the red songthaew shared trucks along the main roads or renting a motorbike. To reach the island you take a ferry across from the Laem Ngop pier in Trat province, about 30–45 minutes, then continue by road on the island. The stay areas in this article: Klong Prao — the longest beach on the island, quieter than White Sand Beach, with both riverside hostels and beachfront resorts. Chai Chet — the headland between White Sand Beach and Klong Prao, with shops and restaurants nearby. Ban Phai Bae–Kai Bae — the middle of the island, with access to several beaches. Bailan Bay — further south, near Lonely Beach, a zone of bars and budget-friendly restaurants. Most of the areas in this article aren't directly on the beachfront, so plan ahead for transport.

entries.type: Hostel/guesthouse 2★ · clean, walkable to the beach
entries.name: The Habitat Hostel
entries.badge: 🧼 Cleaner than the price · walk to Klong Prao Beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chai Chet · about a 5 min walk to Klong Prao Beach
entries.addr: 19/8 Moo 4, Chai Chet Beach, Klong Prao, Ko Chang, Trat
entries.storyHtml: If there's one Koh Chang hostel that plenty of reviews agree is "cleaner than the price," The Habitat Hostel is a name that comes up often. It's a small stay of about 12 rooms in the Chai Chet area, set up simply behind the V.J. Plaza complex in a lane surrounded by restaurants, convenience stores and a laundry, with an overall score of around 8.0 from real reviews. The thing praised most is the cleanliness and newness of the rooms — many guests say the same thing: the rooms feel fresh, roomier than expected, and the beds are comfortable to a level that feels "more hotel than hostel." There are mixed dorms and female-only dorms that come with lockers, reading lights, cold AC and a private bathroom, which not every hostel offers, plus a private room with a balcony of about 24 sqm for those who want more privacy. On location, most reviews note that it's about a 5 minute walk to Klong Prao Beach — the longest beach on the island — and stepping out of the lane puts food and essentials within reach. Service is the consistent point of praise: the owner and staff are described as friendly and very good at booking diving tours and arranging rides. Honest caveats from the reviews: this is not a party hostel — no bar, no on-site venue — so a solo traveler hoping to make new friends may find it a bit quiet, there are occasional reports of insects in some reviews, and there's no pool. It suits budget solo travelers, backpacking couples, and anyone who values cleanliness and a good night's sleep over a social scene.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check directly with the property when you book whether breakfast is included and what the deposit policy is, because the details differ between platforms. Bring mosquito repellent since it's in a lane near a garden, and have the front desk help you flag a songthaew or rent a motorbike.

entries.type: Riverside hostel 1★ · free boat shuttle to the beach
entries.name: Riverview Hostel
entries.badge: 🛶 Highest score in the set · free speedboat shuttle to the beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mouth of the Klong Prao river · free boat shuttle to the beach/short drive
tags: 🛶 Free speedboat shuttle to the beach
entries.addr: Pak Maenam Khlong Phrao, Ko Chang, Mueang Ko Chang, Trat
entries.storyHtml: Among the Koh Chang hostels we reviewed, measured on score, Riverview Hostel is the highest in this set at 9.0 from real reviews, and TripAdvisor lists it among Koh Chang's specialty lodging with a 4.5-star rating. It's a stylishly designed hostel right at the mouth of the Klong Prao river, in one of the quietest corners of the Klong Prao area, between White Sand Beach and Klong Prao village. What clearly sets it apart from other budget stays on the island is the free speedboat shuttle to the beach — a highlight many reviewers love, because you cruise down the river mouth and out to the beach in a few minutes, an experience you won't get from a typical roadside stay. Another thing that's hard to find at hostel prices: every dorm is air-conditioned with its own bathroom and hot water, each bed has a private locker, there's CCTV in the common areas, and there's a deluxe room with a river-view balcony for anyone who wants more privacy. A frequently mentioned highlight is the riverside terrace bar looking out over the river mouth as it flows to the sea — a spot to sip morning coffee and watch the sunset in the evening — plus a shared kitchen for cooking your own meals, free coffee and drinking water, and a host who looks after guests personally and warmly. Honest caveats from the reviews: the property isn't directly on the beachfront, so you rely on the shuttle boat or a motorbike to reach the beach, some private rooms are next to the dorms so you may hear some noise, and there's no pool or breakfast served. It suits solo travelers, pairs, and backpackers who prefer a quiet riverside atmosphere over the bustle of the main beach.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask about the speedboat shuttle's schedule and operating hours in advance so you can plan each day more smoothly. If you want full privacy, pick the deluxe room and ask whether it's next to the dorms before booking. Head up to the terrace bar at sunset, when the atmosphere is at its best.
pros: Highest score in the set at 9.0 · very clean dorms, kitchen and bathrooms
Every dorm has AC and a private bathroom — rare at hostel prices
Free speedboat shuttle to the beach · terrace bar with sunset views
Friendly host who looks after guests well · free coffee and drinking water (from reviews)
cons: Not on the beach, you rely on the shuttle boat or a motorbike to reach it
Some private rooms are next to the dorms, you may hear some noise

entries.type: Budget stay/hostel 2★ · middle of the island
entries.name: Koh Chang Gala
entries.revCount: Overall score around 6.6 · still few public reviews
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Phai Bae–Kai Bae · about a 10 min walk to Klong Prao Beach
entries.addr: 38 Moo 4, Choke Dee, Klong Prao Beach, Ko Chang, Trat
entries.storyHtml: Koh Chang Gala is a stay we have to write about friend-warning-friend style from the start, because it isn't a resort or a stylishly designed hostel — it's a very small budget stay of only about 4 rooms in a two-story building on the main road in the middle of the island, in the Ban Phai Bae–Choke Dee area that sits between Klong Prao Beach and Kai Bae Beach. Its clearest selling point is the low price and the flexible mid-island location — from real reviews and booking-channel data, it's about a 10 minute walk from Klong Prao Beach and around 1 km from Kai Bae Beach, which makes it a base for reaching several beaches and sights, including Klong Plu waterfall, the markets and restaurants around Kai Bae, and the pier for diving. It has useful basics like a tour desk that helps book diving trips, luggage storage, laundry, a small restaurant, a terrace to relax on, free Wi-Fi and free parking. But in fairness to our honesty policy, public reviews are still very few and there are serious complaints — the heaviest point in the negative reviews is the cleanliness of the shared bathrooms, reported as not enough when there are many guests, hot and poorly ventilated rooms in some cases, and staff service attitude at times that made the experience poor. On top of that, at some periods it has operated with shared bathrooms, so confirm the room type before booking, and it isn't on the beach and has no pool. It suits only budget-limited travelers and backpackers who choose it purely for the price and location, with budget-stay expectations set accordingly. Anyone sensitive to cleanliness or traveling with small children should consider a resort in the same area with more verified reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Contact the property directly before booking to confirm the room type, whether it's a private or shared bathroom, and the latest room condition, since it makes a big difference to comfort. Arrange transport in advance because it isn't on the beach, and confirm the airport/pier transfer fare (around ฿600/person) ahead of time.
pros: Very budget price for Koh Chang, good value on a tight budget
Mid-island location, access to several beaches and diving spots
Has a tour desk, free Wi-Fi and free parking
About a 10 min walk to Klong Prao Beach
cons: Few real reviews, serious complaints about shared-bathroom cleanliness and service
Small property of about 4 rooms, not on the beach, needs transport · no pool
At times it's a shared-bathroom setup, confirm before booking

entries.name: OYO 695 My Hostel
entries.badge: 🏊 A pool for a few hundred baht · Bailan Bay area
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bailan Bay · about a 7 min walk to Bailan Beach
entries.storyHtml: Among the few-hundred-baht stays on Koh Chang, what makes OYO 695 My Hostel more interesting than hostels at the same price is that it has an outdoor pool to cool off in after a full day of walking around — something not easy to find at this price. It's a small stay of just 12 rooms in the Bailan Bay area on the west side of Koh Chang, with a moderate score of around 7.4 from about 40 real reviews. Rooms are split into doubles, twins, and a shared-room bed option for solo travelers who want to save the most, with every room having AC, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with free amenities — where many hostels at the same price tend to put you on shared bathrooms. Most real reviews say the rooms are clean to a level that's acceptable for the price, the AC is nice and cold, and the beds are comfortable enough to sleep on without expecting luxury. On location, it's about a 7 min walk from the property to Bailan Beach (roughly 600–700 m) and around 800 m to 1.2 km from Lonely Beach, the zone known for its budget-friendly bars and restaurants, while still being quieter than staying right in the middle of the Lonely Beach zone. Inside there's the Lemon Bar restaurant and bar serving Thai and international food, free Wi-Fi, free parking and laundry service. Honest caveats from the reviews: the rooms are small and simply decorated — this isn't a luxury stay — it's in a lane away from the beach so you have to walk or ride to the beach, the review count is still low which makes consistency hard to judge, and it's an OYO-chain property whose quality depends on the on-site manager. It suits budget travelers, backpackers and couples on a tight budget who want a private AC room and a pool for a few hundred baht and plan to spend most of their time out of the room.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The stay is in a lane away from the beach and Koh Chang's roads are steep in places, so renting a motorbike for mobility is recommended — there's free parking. It's a small OYO-chain property with still-few reviews, so reconfirm your booking before you travel, keep your records, and choose free cancellation first if your plans aren't set.
pros: Has a pool, which is rare among few-hundred-baht stays on Koh Chang
AC rooms with private bathrooms, both doubles and shared rooms
Bailan Bay location, walkable to Bailan Beach, near Lonely Beach
Has the Lemon Bar restaurant, free Wi-Fi and free parking
cons: In a lane, not on the beach, you have to walk or ride to the beach
Small, simply decorated rooms in budget-stay style
OYO chain with still-few reviews, quality depends on the on-site manager, reconfirm your booking first

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting prices from the range for standard rooms/dorm beds and may change by date and season. We recommend checking the actual price and comparing 3 sites before every booking. The scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms, not from staying ourselves. Most of these hostel-style stays are small properties (around 4–12 rooms), so they fill up fast in high season (November–April) — book ahead. Many aren't directly on the beachfront, so plan for transport or a beach shuttle boat. Koh Chang has a distinct rainy season (around May–October) when some periods see heavy rain and some services on the island close, so check the weather and the ferry schedule before you travel, and choose free cancellation first if your plans aren't set. To reach the island you take a ferry across from the Laem Ngop pier in Trat, about 30–45 minutes. Article by Thailandaddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travelers often ask about hostel-style stays on Koh Chang

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best hostel-style stay on Koh Chang?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style. Measured on score, Riverview Hostel is the highest in this article at 9.0, a hostel at the mouth of the Klong Prao river with a free speedboat shuttle to the beach. If you want a clean hostel walkable to the beach, The Habitat Hostel scores 8.0 with rooms cleaner than the price. If you want a pool for a few hundred baht, OYO 695 My Hostel. And if you're focused on the lowest price as a base for exploring mid-island, Koh Chang Gala — but confirm the details before booking since reviews are still few.

faq.q: ❓ How much does a hostel stay on Koh Chang cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at about ฿250–700 per night/bed. The cheapest end is Riverview Hostel from ฿250/bed and The Habitat Hostel from ฿450/dorm bed. Koh Chang Gala starts around ฿500–700. OYO 695 My Hostel's private rooms start around ฿700–1,030 (dorm beds are cheaper). All prices are approximate starting prices; in high season and on long holidays prices may run higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Which area should you stay in if you want a hostel on Koh Chang?
faq.a: Klong Prao — the longest beach on the island, quiet, with a riverside hostel (Riverview Hostel). Chai Chet — a headland with shops nearby, walkable to Klong Prao Beach (The Habitat Hostel). Ban Phai Bae–Kai Bae — mid-island with access to several beaches (Koh Chang Gala). Bailan Bay — near Lonely Beach, a zone of budget-friendly bars (OYO 695 My Hostel). Most aren't directly on the beachfront, so plan ahead for transport.

faq.q: ❓ Which Koh Chang hostel has AC dorms with private bathrooms?
faq.a: Riverview Hostel stands out most on this — every dorm is air-conditioned with its own bathroom and hot water, which is hard to find at dorm prices. The Habitat Hostel's dorms also have AC and private bathrooms. As for OYO 695 My Hostel, its private rooms all have AC and a private bathroom, and there's a shared-room bed option too.

faq.q: ❓ Which Koh Chang hostel has a pool?
faq.a: In this article only OYO 695 My Hostel has an outdoor pool, which is rare among the few-hundred-baht stays on the island. The Habitat Hostel, Riverview Hostel and Koh Chang Gala have no pool, so anyone who wants to swim has to walk or travel to a nearby beach — Riverview Hostel makes up for it with a free speedboat shuttle to the beach.

faq.q: ❓ Are Koh Chang hostels walkable to the beach · do you need a motorbike?
faq.a: Most aren't directly on the beachfront. The Habitat Hostel is about a 5 min walk to Klong Prao Beach and OYO 695 My Hostel is about a 7 min walk to Bailan Beach, both considered walkable. Riverview Hostel is on the river with a free speedboat shuttle to the beach. Koh Chang Gala is mid-island, about a 10 min walk to Klong Prao Beach. Koh Chang has no convenient public transport, so renting a motorbike or planning around the songthaew shared trucks is recommended for reaching other beaches and waterfalls.
